text.content:
Security, banking, and a hand in everything else.

Headquarters: Tokyo; its Night City tower stands in the Corporate Plaza
Industry: Security, banking, arms, and hundreds of subsidiaries
Leadership: Saburo Arasaka, CEO since 1960
In Night City: The city's biggest employer and its dominant power since the Unification War
Dealing with edgerunners: Hires them through layers of deniability; its guards are the best-trained you'll meet

The oldest megacorp still standing. Arasaka fought Militech in the 4th Corporate War, lost its Night City tower to a nuclear blast in 2023, and came back in force in 2070, when its supercarrier in Coronado Bay ended the Unification War.

Banking and security make most of its money, but some subsidiary of Arasaka makes, imports or sells almost anything you can name.

Gig hooks

  • A mid-level Arasaka banker wants out, with the account data in their head.
  • Someone is selling Arasaka guard rotations for the Waterfront. Is it bait?

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.23
